ValidationRule.description: All Customer Contact fields on the Account are required when an Opportunity reaches proposal stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Opportunity_at_Proposal_Stage__c = TRUE, NOT(RecordType.Name = "Competitor"), NOT(RecordType.Name = "Partner"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Customer_Contact_Level__c,""), ISPICKVAL(Customer_Contact_Department__c,""), ISBLANK(Customer_Contact_Email__c), ISBLANK(Customer_Contact_Name__c), ISBLANK(Customer_Contact_Title_Designation__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All People Soft Customer Contact fields on the Account are required when an Opportunity reaches proposal stage.
